verification_limitations: Prototype screening evidence is not taxonomic validation.
No reference label is independently human taxonomically verified.
Provider-supported retrieval consistency is not classification accuracy.
Scores and margins are uncalibrated and are not probabilities.
Seventy-nine of 81 frozen references are research-only and must not be displayed as image copies.
Larval support is sparse and pinned-specimen support is absent.
Regional reference conditioning remains diagnostic where sparse clusters cannot preserve target scoreability.
